### Install

Open [Zen Recorder on Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/zen-recorder/) and click **Add to Firefox**. It works in
Firefox 140 or later and in the browsers built on it (Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox and
others), on the desktop. Accept the install prompt: it lists the sites the recorder works on
(Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams); leave them all allowed.

Or install the `.xpi` below, the same file signed by Mozilla: download it, then drag it onto a
browser window, or open `about:addons`, click the gear icon and choose **Install Add-on From
File…**.

**Zen:** the same steps. You do not need to change any pref, because the file is signed.

**Updates are automatic**, from addons.mozilla.org, however you installed it. After an update the
popup may show **Grant access** for a service that is new in that version: Firefox asks for each
site's permission separately.

The `-sources.zip` asset holds the source code this version was built from.

### About

> Zen Recorder is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by
> Zen Browser or its team. The maintainer uses Zen Browser, which is why the recorder targets
> Firefox-based browsers.

Nothing leaves your machine: no servers, no accounts, no uploads, no telemetry. The
[privacy policy](https://zenfully-org.github.io/zen-recorder/privacy.html) says what the extension
stores and where.
